articles.title: Appeals court rules Trump can’t build White House ballroom without congressional approval
articles.description:
The Republican president said on social media that the administration will immediately appeal what he called an “unjust decision” to the U.S. Supreme Court.

The post Appeals court rules Trump can’t build White House ballroom without congressional approval appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Appeals court denies Trump's plan to build a White House ballroom without Congress approval.
Trump plans to appeal this decision to the U.S. Supreme Court immediately.
Boston residents may see delays in federal projects due to ongoing legal battles.

articles.title: An 8-foot Bigfoot was spotted in Connecticut last month. It’s far from New England’s first.
articles.description:
“I feel crazy saying it,” the witness said. “It's just unbelievable. I keep telling people you have to see it to believe it. I can't convince you and I'm not even going to try.”

summary: Witness reported an 8-foot Bigfoot sighting in Connecticut last month.

Local residents may experience increased interest in regional folklore and tourism.

articles.title: Blanche narrowly confirmed as Trump’s AG in overnight vote
articles.description:
Blanche was confirmed by the narrowest of margins, opposed by two Republicans — Sens. Susan Collins of Maine and Lisa Murkowski of Alaska — and by every Democrat.

The post Blanche narrowly confirmed as Trump’s AG in overnight vote appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Blanche confirmed as Attorney General by a narrow margin of 51-49 votes.
Opposition included two Republicans, Senators Collins and Murkowski, and all Democrats.
Boston residents may see changes in federal law enforcement priorities under Blanche's leadership.
